description: Next.js pages-router app. Filename-routed pages and middleware, a script referenced only from CI, a tool referenced only from the README, framework-implied dependencies, knip configured but not installed, an unused local variable (a linter-level nitpick), an unused module-level constant, an old orphan, and an orphan committed 2 days ago.
prompt: Audit this repository for dead code and report your findings.

Nothing imports it, and it has been in history for over a year.

must_not_flag.why: Unused local variable: a linter-level nitpick the spec says not to report.
Referenced only from .github/workflows/sitemap.yml, which is a real reference.
Referenced only from README, which is a real reference.
next, react and react-dom are required by Next.js even where not imported by name.
